mapper.update: TRUNCATE crawl.movie_now_showing_stat; INSERT INTO crawl.movie_now_showing_stat (movie_id, show_time_count, next_show_time, refreshed_at) SELECT mst.movie_id, COUNT(*)::INTEGER, MIN(mst.start_time::timestamp), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM movie_show_time mst INNER JOIN movie m ON m.id = mst.movie_id AND m.kind = 'movie' WHERE mst.deleted = 0 AND mst.open = TRUE AND mst.start_time >= to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY mst.movie_id
